# @solana-programs/kamino-lending

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@solana-programs/kamino-lending.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@solana-programs/kamino-lending)

TypeScript client for the Kamino Lending and Kamino Farms programs

<!-- Generated by `bun run codegen` from programs/bundles.ts. Do not edit. -->

## Installation

```bash
bun add @solana-programs/kamino-lending @solana/kit
```

## Included programs

This package contains no code of its own: it re-exports everything from the following packages, which can also be installed individually:

- `kaminoLending`: [`@solana-programs/kamino-klend`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@solana-programs/kamino-klend)
- `farms`: [`@solana-programs/kamino-farms`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@solana-programs/kamino-farms)

## Name conflicts

24 name(s) are exported by more than one of these programs. The flat export resolves to the program listed first above; the other programs are also exported in full under a namespace:

- `farms` (`import { farms } from "@solana-programs/kamino-lending"`)
